source: make ops-replay — Bank today [data] and the W3 replay [simulated], memory store, ops manifest v1

bank_today.name: Bank today
bank_today.label: [data]
bank_today.source: queries/ops/asis_monthly.sql on gold complaints; FCR from queries/pitch/p02_fcr_complaint_vs_bank.csv

notes.days_to_receipt: First response date minus creation date, in days: the closest proxy the dataset has; it records no receipt or legal deadline. Complaints with no first response are left out (missing).
notes.first_contact_resolution: FCR of the bank's 'Queja' call-center contacts over the whole dataset window (43.6%). The interactions table is not in this repo's gold, so it cannot be split per month: the same value repeats.
notes.escalated: Complaints with status Escalated at the dataset's snapshot.
notes.outside_sla_at_intake: The dataset's own sla_breached flag, counted by intake month.
notes.resolution_days: Bank only: a person decides the final resolution, so it is not simulated.

replay.name: With Nick of Time (simulated)
replay.label: [simulated]
replay.source: python -m data.ops replay: B0 + search_transaction + PolicyEngine.decide over gold complaints, then the spec 14 job (ops_kpis, mode replay)

notes.days_to_receipt: 0 days: the receipt with its legal deadline is given in the same conversation. Contacts with no such receipt (asked, or opened with no deadline) are missing.
notes.first_contact_resolution: The safe automated path: card blocked and verified, case opened, no person, over all contacts.
notes.escalated: Cases handed to a person at intake (zone medium or human), over all contacts.
notes.outside_sla_at_intake: Cases opened at first contact with no legal deadline (the clock is unknown for that date), over cases opened.
notes.asked: The engine asks when the search finds several candidate charges, or none; the contact ends there in the replay, since the dataset does not say which charge the customer meant.

live.name: Live
live.reason: spec 14 T5 (the Postgres source) has not run on live traffic
